scope: Constructed visible-state single-step legal actions and heuristic scores; no full-game training or accuracy claim.
knownIntentionalDifferences: whip applies to each devour, not main opening; independent Saw/Whip/chain-Collar probabilities combine before the Rainbow cap
skewer adds one tier to every legal rat devour
ring secondary openings omit main opening bonuses (the original JS score already omitted those bonuses)
ratway offers every non-office room and excludes ordinary walking/Chain/Shackles/walk-objective scoring

Execution uses strictly lower-tier base-counter species, without legendary or skewer extra-prey relations; audit patches only that predicate in a separately labelled in-memory JS oracle. This interpretation was checked against reference behaviour, not newly measured in the live game.
ChainArmed ordinary patrol opens suppress main-opening Keys/Fire/Dogtag/Blacklist and destination-event bonuses
